baseline_pinned_reason: HAZARDS.md #12 — HEAD is not the baseline, a sibling bank can carry an uncommitted edit into it. Pinned before building anything.
could_not_do: Did not generate ROADMAP.md from roadmap.json. The prose in ROADMAP.md carries deliberate reasoning (why-first framing, named mechanisms, quoted judge language) that a records->markdown generator would flatten into a table. Per the brief's own fallback, built a drift check instead (tools/roadmap.mjs --check-drift, wired into the main run): it asserts every roadmap.json step id has a matching heading in ROADMAP.md and vice versa, and fails loudly (non-zero exit, printed to stderr) on a mismatch. Not run as a commit-time gate (pre-commit hook already regenerates 5 files; adding a 6th mandatory gate was out of scope for this piece), but callable on demand and by CI if wired in later.

Evidence entries in orchestration/roadmap.json are a representative set per step, not exhaustive proof of every claim in ROADMAP.md's prose. Each step has 2-3 evidence entries pointing at the load-bearing status file / instrument / gate for its current claimed state, chosen to be independently checkable, not a citation of every sentence.

Two closes_when conditions (step 2's 'looks right to a person', step 5's 'how fun it feels') are genuinely human-judgement conditions with no filed verdict on disk. Per the scope-discipline instruction, I did NOT invent a mechanical proxy for either — I recorded them with an `unevidenced_note` field on the step explaining what a real closing verdict would need to be (a blind-judgement or capture-review verdict naming the step), and they are listed again below.

Did not run any browser or GPU-pod command as part of this tool or its self-test — offline only, per the dispatch's 'no browser, no GPU'. tools/roadmap.mjs's evidence commands are limited to cheap, offline Node checks (all <2s when timed).
headline: orchestration/roadmap.json (7 steps incl. 3 sub-steps of step 1, plus 2 standing-work entries) and tools/roadmap.mjs built and self-tested. The tool verifies every done/in_progress claim against its named evidence at run time, reports UNVERIFIED loudly when evidence is missing, writes docs/data/roadmap.json, and is wired into tools/publish.mjs and docs/progress.html following the cost-report.mjs pattern (a separate report module, not a second page-building path). Self-test passes 3/3 required-disagreeing arms.

steps_needing_criteria_that_were_too_vag.why_not_evidenced: human judgement, no verdict schema instance exists yet naming this step
steps_needing_criteria_that_were_too_vag.what_would_close_it: a blind-judgement (or capture-review) verdict under corpus/90-verdicts/ that names step-2 / the Thorn opening path and reads PASS
